verdict.rationale: Firebase's CLI is documented to run headlessly (firebase-probe-5 shows `npx firebase-tools --version` working without login) and can deploy functions, security rules, and manage Auth users via CLI commands (firebase-gh-1, firebase-docs-8, firebase-docs-10/18). The MCP server also exposes agent-usable tools to create/manage Firebase projects, Auth users, and Firestore/SQL data (firebase-docs-20, firebase-probe-6), supporting an agent-driven, scriptable backend setup. However, there is no single documented script or hands-on example showing an agent standing up schema+auth+policies together in one headless flow — missing for 10: an end-to-end scripted example combining Firestore schema/rules deployment, Auth configuration, and policy enforcement in a single non-interactive CLI/script run, and independent verification of non-interactive `firebase init` for new projects.
